templates.description: Turn one photo into a playful wizard transformation. The golden spell ring spins around the scene as the hat pops in, wand swings, starlight pulses and spins, and the enchanted book bounces into place before the editable LEVEL UP! title springs into view. Your photo remains full-screen throughout; no cutout or face tracking is needed.
